title: Pooled seats
description: One row per seat-event as a source states it (data/master/master_<state>.parquet).

fields.name: dataset_id
fields.description: state_slug/tier/year: the slice the row belongs to.

fields.name: row_id
fields.description: Stable row identifier: sha1 of source repository, path, page, seat key and occurrence, first 12 hex digits. Changes when provenance changes.

fields.name: seat_key
fields.description: The ten seat-identity parts joined by '|' ('|' and '%' escaped). Not unique: a source can state a seat twice.

fields.name: seat_key_unique
fields.description: True when no other row in the pooled corpus has this seat_key.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Printed name of the state.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year.

fields.name: election_type
fields.description: General or by-election, where the source names it (Rajasthan).

fields.name: election_duration
fields.description: The polling period as the source prints it.

fields.name: district
fields.description: District as printed.

fields.name: block
fields.description: Block, mandal or taluk as printed.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Local body name where the source names one.

fields.name: gp_no
fields.description: Panchayat number as printed.

fields.name: gram_panchayat
fields.description: Panchayat as printed.

fields.name: gp_term
fields.description: Which word the source used for the panchayat.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward number as printed (may carry a suffix).

fields.name: ward_name
fields.description: Ward name as printed.

fields.name: seat_no
fields.description: Seat number within a multi-member ward.

fields.name: district_latin
fields.description: District romanized by tools/transliterate.py.

fields.name: block_latin
fields.description: Block romanized by tools/transliterate.py.

fields.name: gram_panchayat_latin
fields.description: Panchayat romanized by tools/transliterate.py.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Canonical office (canon.py maps local names onto it).

fields.name: tier_local
fields.description: The office as the state names it.

fields.name: caste_reservation
fields.description: Caste category the seat is reserved for; NONE = unreserved. A property of the seat, never of the winner.

fields.name: caste_reservation_local
fields.description: The state's own caste label before the fold to SC/ST/BC/NONE.

fields.name: caste_scheme
fields.description: The state's reservation regime, which fixes what BC means.

fields.name: woman_reserved
fields.description: Seat reserved for a woman. Never filled from a name.

fields.name: reservation
fields.description: Caste and woman reservation combined.

fields.name: reservation_raw
fields.description: The reservation exactly as printed.

fields.name: listing_scope
fields.description: Whether the source lists every seat or only some.

fields.name: unit_of_observation
fields.description: seat, or seat_from_candidates where a candidate-level source was collapsed to seats.

fields.name: seat_candidates
fields.description: Number of candidates, where the row was collapsed from candidates.

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Elected person as printed.

fields.name: winner_latin
fields.description: Winner romanized by tools/transliterate.py.

fields.name: winner_basis
fields.description: How the winner is known.

fields.name: votes
fields.description: Winner's votes.

fields.name: runner_up
fields.description: Second-placed candidate as printed.

fields.name: runner_up_votes
fields.description: Runner-up's votes.

fields.name: margin
fields.description: Winner's votes minus runner-up's.

fields.name: vacant
fields.description: No one was elected.

fields.name: unopposed
fields.description: Elected without a contest.

fields.name: script
fields.description: Script of the printed names.

fields.name: source_repo
fields.description: Repository the row was read from.

fields.name: source_commit
fields.description: Full commit of source_repo the row was read at.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: File within source_repo.

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: 1-based page of source_path, for documents.

fields.name: provenance_level
fields.description: The finest unit a row can be traced to.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: ';'-joined flags a consumer should read before trusting the row (master.quality_flags).
